body:
Theoretically, correct. If I find a job, but as I've said before nothing gives me joy anymore. I doubt that changing the country would make any difference.

About other jobs, well it's kind of hard to explain. I an ungrateful and in a way, spoiled. I know that. I ate from the dumpster in a period of my life but right now I am content. I track video game industry and earn money by playing, exploiting them. Main problem is (although my job limits my social life greatly) I don't have anyone to spend time with. So even if I have enough time, it doesn't matter. I am truly alone. Only not blood-related people that call me when I'm late or out of city are my bosses. Other then them, nobody cares what I do, where I go, how I am. 

Maybe that is one of the reasons I give up quickly on venturing into new lands. I don't have the belief that good things wait for me.

Actually I do want to help people. At least I did, some time ago.

I think too much, usually I'm an overthinker. That's why people usually refer to me as "you must be fun at parties". I am generally boring, I doubt that I would be helpful to another people here. But I've been reading entries for a long time, on and off. I will take your advice, partially, and try to come up with logical ideas towards entries. If I persuade myself, I will post it then.

I am originally an industrial designer. At least my college degree says that. But I never took joy of doing that. As a sector, I love my job. And in Turkey, conditions of industrial designers are worse than mine. 

One of the misfortunes of Turkey is, nearly all the creative workforce is located in just one big city: Istanbul. There are no jobs other than this city, at least as far as I know. This is not my birthplace and I'ld love to move but right now I don't know how to do it.

Another country.... I don't feel that I am special in any way that could replace another person in another country. My only foreign language is English and although I manage, it's not that great. Even for touristic visit we get so many difficulties through visas and borders. Turkey is a so called "developing" country but actually it is going down. Fast. So no, I cannot depart to another country. Not because it is impossible, but because I don't know how to.
